known_defects.title: build_completed_hour_oi is non-functional (AttributeError on any non-empty input)
known_defects.detail: src/trading_bot/research/h6/eligibility.py::build_completed_hour_oi does `ts_to_use = _hour_close_boundaries(...)` (a plain TUPLE) then accesses `ts_to_use.start` / `ts_to_use.end` -> AttributeError for any non-empty snapshot list; it only 'works' on an empty list where the predicate is never evaluated.
